domains.name: Question and system model
domains.interpretation: Clear technical question and enough system/workflow description to locate the proposed mechanism.

domains.name: Assumptions, variables and constraints
domains.interpretation: Explicit critical assumptions, decision variables and constraints or experimental boundaries.

domains.name: Reproducible configuration
domains.interpretation: Operational setup and key parameter values sufficient to interpret and plausibly reconstruct the reported experiment. Identify material gaps.

domains.name: Baseline comparability
domains.interpretation: Named comparators and evidence of common workloads, resources, protocol or stated differences. Distinguish tunings disclosed from tuning parity not established.

domains.name: Metric–objective alignment
domains.interpretation: Key outcomes measure the stated objective. Note simulation proxy or mismatch if material.

domains.name: Variability, repetitions, sensitivity or convergence
domains.interpretation: Assess facets applicable to the design. A sensitivity sweep or convergence plot alone does not establish uncertainty across repeated random trials.

domains.name: Network and mobility realism relative to claims
domains.interpretation: Compare channel, mobility, network, topology assumptions and evaluation modality with the actual scope claimed. Simulation is not automatically inadequate.

domains.name: Claim bounds
domains.interpretation: Identify how claims and conclusions are bounded to the evaluated workloads, scenarios, systems and modality. Cite both scope and claim if needed.

domains.name: Code, data, traces and implementation availability
domains.interpretation: Identify an explicit release, access route, statement of restriction, or the exact methods, end matter and supplement sections checked for availability. Mention of a named component or third-party dataset is not author artifact availability.

domains.name: Limitations, funding and conflict reporting
domains.interpretation: Give explicit evidence for each of three subfacets as reported or searched; an acknowledgment listing funding does not establish absence of conflicts. Distinguish implicit setup boundaries from explicit author limitations.
